report.lite-evidence.heading: ## Lite Evidence
report.lite-evidence.body: - Record explicit Lite authorization and the evidence gate used to justify it.

report.step-evidence.heading: ## Step Evidence
report.step-evidence.body:
- Record Red, Green, and refactor evidence for each executed step.
- Link each closure id to its observed verification result.

report.strict-evidence.heading: ## Strict Evidence
report.strict-evidence.body:
- Record reviewer gate status, discovered tests, and unresolved risks.
- Preserve stale authority or marker conflict observations.

report.critical-evidence.heading: ## Critical Evidence
report.critical-evidence.body: - Record critical controls, rollback/revisit notes, and final quality gate disposition.
